answer: A concrete approach: chain each registration to a per-identity nonce derived from the prior epoch hash so clones collide. Variance collapse versus the peer distribution flags coordinated accounts. Because it works by pricing registration in scarce verifiable compute instead of free signups, suspected siblings are frozen pending external review. The oasis of work and the tundra of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a mirror to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
